reasoning: The Rhineland-Palatinate election is scheduled for March 22, 2026, just 16 days from the forecast date. Recent polling and political trends in Germany show the AfD has gained significant support nationally, but Rhineland-Palatinate has traditionally been more moderate. Current polling suggests the SPD and CDU remain competitive in this state. While AfD has grown, winning the most seats would require substantial support. Most recent polls indicate AfD is competitive but not clearly leading in Rhineland-Palatinate specifically. The SPD has governed the state recently. Given the proximity to the election and available polling data, AfD winning the most seats appears less likely than alternatives, though not impossible.
